items.t: Said the Panama Canal is run by Chinese soldiers. It is operated by an agency of the Panamanian government.
Said 38,000 Americans died building the Panama Canal. According to fact-checkers, fewer than 1,000 Americans did.
Called Zelensky a dictator. His term would indeed have ended in peacetime, but elections are suspended because of the war and martial law. The claim leaves out that context.
Said the US spent far more on military aid to Ukraine than Europe did. Dutch Defence Minister Brekelmans said this is not correct.
Told Ukraine it should never have started the war. Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022.
Said in Congress that the US had given Ukraine $350 billion. VRT NWS found the US had not (so far) given that much.
items.v: VRT NWS: does not hold up

items.t: Said in Davos that Europeans would not stand with the US in NATO. The idea that Europeans were unwilling to support the US in the past does not hold up.
items.v: VRT NWS: does not hold up

items.t: Made several false or misleading statements in Davos about NATO, the history of Greenland and the US housing market.
Claimed in the State of the Union that he brought in $18 trillion in foreign investment. The White House’s own website cites a lower figure.
Said other countries pay the tariffs. Research shows they are mostly paid by US importers and consumers.
Said he inherited record-high inflation. Inflation was 3.0% in January 2025 and 2.4% in January 2026.
Claimed some $18 trillion in investment has come to the US in his second term. The White House’s own website said $10.6 trillion, which CNN says is itself a major exaggeration.
Said factory construction is rising. According to CNN, spending on manufacturing construction is actually falling.
Said at the NATO summit in Ankara that record numbers of plants are being built. Federal data shows manufacturing construction spending has fallen steadily during his second term.
Repeated that 25 million people crossed the border under Biden. CNN calls that figure false; even his earlier 21 million was a wild exaggeration.

Again accused China of interfering in elections and repeated unfounded claims that voting systems are vulnerable. He offered no evidence, and the claims contradict the conclusions of US intelligence agencies.
Repeated at the Republican convention in Dallas that more than $20 trillion has been invested in the US during his second term.
Again said he achieved “no tax on Social Security” for seniors. CNN calls this a false claim.
Said Americans’ 401(k)s are up by about $46,000. Stocks rose, but PolitiFact says that amount is not supported.
